title: G1 (CORE): Implicit observed-only matvec for the nr×nr system must be derived and proved (no O(M)/O(N))

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** the system matrix $\mathcal A=(Z\otimes K)^\top S S^\top (Z\otimes K)+\lambda(I_r\otimes K)$ in ($\star$).

The PCG inner loop needs the action $v=\mathrm{vec}(W)\mapsto\mathcal A v$ computed **without** forming $Z\otimes K$ ($N\times nr$), the dense $KWZ^\top$ ($n\times M$), or any $O(N)$ vector. A correct derivation must prove:

1. $(Z\otimes K)\mathrm{vec}(W)=\mathrm{vec}(KWZ^\top)$ and $(Z\otimes K)^\top\mathrm{vec}(R)=\mathrm{vec}(KRZ)$ (Kronecker–vec identity).
2. $SS^\top$ is the 0/1 diagonal mask onto observed coordinates of $\mathbb R^N$.
3. Column-major unfolding: observed flat index $p\Rightarrow (i,m)=(p\bmod n,\lfloor p/n\rfloor)$.

Resulting algorithm (must be proved correct): $C=KW$ ($O(n^2r)$); for each observed $(i,m)$, $u_p=\langle C_{i,:},Z_{m,:}\rangle$ ($O(qr)$, touching only rows $\tilde K,\tilde Z$); scatter $u$ to sparse $R$; return $\mathrm{vec}(K(RZ))+\lambda\,\mathrm{vec}(KW)$ with $RZ\in\mathbb R^{n\times r}$ assembled by scatter ($O(qr+n^2r)$). Net **$O(n^2r+qr)$ per matvec**, free of $M,N$.

Verified numerically in-session (matches dense $\mathcal A v$ to $10^{-14}$). The attempt must *prove* the identity, not assert it; the common failure is silently materializing the $n\times M$ intermediate (an $O(M)$ step).
